notes: «حدثنا أبي رضي الله عنه» — bare «أبي» is the compiler's father, a relation; the blessing is left out
«قال: كان أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام يقول» names the Imam only in the words after the chain: last link, imam_in_text, written as the report names him
the sayings that follow are the Imam's words, not chain
